subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation treat the global browser SSRF private-network policy as authorization in addition to models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork?
rationale: Both choices are technically implementable, but deciding whether a browser-scoped global policy may authorize provider image traffic changes a security boundary and must reflect maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve both explicit opt-ins
options.body: Keep the current shared-path implementation so either the global SSRF policy or the xAI provider request setting authorizes private-network image requests, matching the established OpenAI image precedent.

options.title: Require provider-specific opt-in
options.body: Narrow authorization to models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork so browser policy cannot independently authorize xAI provider traffic.

options.title: Pause private xAI routing
options.body: Leave the current default-deny behavior unchanged until a broader cross-provider private-network policy is designed and documented.

recommendation.title: Approve both explicit opt-ins
recommendation.body: Keep the current shared-path implementation so either the global SSRF policy or the xAI provider request setting authorizes private-network image requests, matching the established OpenAI image precedent.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the exact shared SSRF policy and provider-request boundary represented by this person's recent work.
